target.title: perf(repair): stage validation proof gates
target.body:
## Summary

- plan repair validation as ordered, risk-aware proof stages and independently rebuild exact proof semantics before replay
- keep untrusted execution credential-free and lifecycle-script-free; bind immutable source, base, head, action, and output identities
- publish only exact independently validated commit and tree bytes through credential-scoped mutation jobs
- recheck live pause and structured security signals at every mutation boundary
- checkpoint replacement publication before irreversible source closeout and recover only the exact authorized replacement PR
- make retryable post-flight outcomes visible and durable for self-heal
- resolve rerun handoff artifacts by trusted producer artifact ID and digest instead of consumer attempt names
- reject unsafe command aliases and options, source mutation, proof drift, and terminal runtime budgets

## Final hardening

- revalidate every sealed issue and PR source in the shared guard immediately before privileged push/create/reopen/label/comment/close mutations
- allow source drift only for the exact prepared source head or a closure recorded by the verified publication checkpoint
- fail closed when a configured canonical changed-gate script disappears
- allow only narrow read-only package-manager proof forms; reject lifecycle, registry, and account mutations across pnpm, npm, Bun, and Yarn
- keep deadline-expired pending or missing checks retryable for durable self-heal
- snapshot ignored dependency/tooling inputs and symlink targets around every staged proof command
- verify every applicable strict ruleset, including bypass actors and the full effective required-check set
- bind issue-implementation readiness to the exact head in the verified publication receipt

## Validation

- exact head: `d4e6e7db6052acaae628c9f1713ea4f52d46b428`
- Node 26.5.0 / pnpm 11.10.0
- focused hardening suites: execution handoff 25/25; post-flight 16/16; target validation 72/72; strict binding/post-flight 36/36
- full unit suite: 922/922 passed
- full repair suite: 839/839 passed
- changed coverage: 100% lines, 86.90% branches, 100% functions
- aggregate coverage: 73.17% lines, 72.19% branches, 83.26% functions
- direct `pnpm run check` equivalents passed: active-surface and limits checks, all three TypeScript builds, all four lint lanes, unit and repair suites, changed and aggregate coverage, and formatter check on 350 files
- the pnpm script wrapper refused before execution because it attempted a non-TTY reinstall of the shared `node_modules` (`ERR_PNPM_ABORTED_REMOVE_MODULES_DIR_NO_TTY`); no install or dependency replacement was performed
- GitHub checks: 6/6 passed, including `pnpm check`, CodeQL for Actions and JavaScript/TypeScript, and the Windows Codex launcher

target.title: feat(ledger): add immutable action history core
target.body:
## Summary

- add immutable, create-only JSONL action shards with deterministic replay and conflict detection
- restrict identity inputs to strict canonical JSON with safe integers only; large identifiers must be strings
- require explicit outcome-independent idempotency identities for mutations
- bind repository and SHA into replay-stable producer identities and shard paths
- preserve source timestamps while deterministically sorting causal children after parents
- keep CrabFleet projection failures durable without logging response bodies

## Independent Review Hardening

- snapshot every parent directory by device and inode immediately around open, write, hard-link, and cleanup mutations
- verify opened descriptors and linked files still identify the expected path; parent swaps fail closed before reporting success
- reject whitespace-delimited and mixed-case bearer/API credentials plus case-insensitive private paths
- reject credential identity aliases including `authToken`, `githubToken`, `refresh_token`, and `cloudflareApiToken`
- reject unsafe JavaScript integers before identity hashing
- align schema and runtime rejection for private IPv6, dot-only paths, UNC/backslash paths, mixed-case private paths, credential-bearing paths, and unsafe integers

## Design

- local writers spool one immutable event file per transition
- workflow finalization batches events into one digest-addressed shard per full producer identity
- shard paths are `ledger/v1/events/YYYY/MM/DD/<producer-repo>/<producer>/<run-attempt-job-digest>.jsonl`
- shard partitions derive only from immutable workflow metadata or an explicit stable date
- source timestamps remain evidence; causal topology resolves ordering conflicts
- mutable comments, dashboards, sessions, command ledgers, and evidence graphs remain projections

## Validation

- `pnpm --config.verify-deps-before-run=false run build`
- focused type-aware `oxlint`
- `node --test test/action-ledger.test.ts test/action-ledger-runtime.test.ts` (`51/51`)
- `pnpm --config.verify-deps-before-run=false run check`
  - unit tests: `973/973`
  - repair tests: `723/723`
  - coverage, lint, TypeScript, active-surface, limits, and formatting passed
- adversarial parent swap-and-restore regression
- full-event schema validation differentials for every cited parity gap

## Follow-ups

- instrument review/apply and sweep publication
- instrument command, repair, notification, and operational workflows
- bind review and closure evidence to Gitcrawl snapshots and Cloudflare archive queries
- add deterministic projection rebuilds and retention compaction

target.title: ci(cloudflare): deploy crawl-remote from protected ClawSweeper environment
target.body:
## Summary

- build and validate the exact current `openclaw/crawl-remote` `main` SHA on an unprivileged runner
- publish a bounded immutable release artifact, then consume it from a fresh protected runner that never executes target lifecycle code
- require the protected environment to explicitly assign deployment authority to ClawSweeper and bind a unique Cloudflare token by SHA-256 fingerprint
- prove workers.dev unconditionally; optionally prove the Access-gated custom route with protected service-token headers
- capture the prior stable Worker version and roll traffic back on deploy failure, post-deploy `main` drift, or failed production proof
- package only the exact reviewed D1 migration sequence and SHA-256 content set

## Security boundary

- preflight receives no Cloudflare credential and mints only a repository-scoped read token
- production remains disabled unless `CRAWL_REMOTE_DEPLOY_AUTHORITY=clawsweeper-v1`
- credentialed steps accept only `CRAWL_REMOTE_PRODUCTION_CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN` from the protected environment and verify it against `CRAWL_REMOTE_CLOUDFLARE_TOKEN_SHA256`
- no repository-secret or generic-token fallback exists
- protected environment variables are resolved only inside protected steps; custom-route proof mode is mandatory and may be `disabled` or `access-service-token`
- exact current-main authorization runs before D1 mutation, before Worker deployment, and after Worker deployment
- failed releases restore the exact previous 100% Worker version; forward D1 migrations remain applied and must preserve compatibility with both versions

## Coordinated authority cutover

Companion retirement PR: https://github.com/openclaw/crawl-remote/pull/37

1. Merge this PR while `CRAWL_REMOTE_DEPLOY_AUTHORITY` remains unset. The new deploy path is present but fail-closed.
2. Merge the companion PR to remove crawl-remote's service-owned production mutator.
3. Configure the protected `crawl-remote-production` environment with the authority value, unique token, token fingerprint, and selected custom-route proof mode.
4. Dispatch only the then-current exact crawl-remote `main` SHA with `observation_order_state=dormant` for the first rollout.

## Validation

- `pnpm run check`: 1,663 tests plus formatting and static gates
- focused deployment workflow tests: 17/17
- pinned Wrangler `4.107.1` command and JSON-contract inspection
- real Wrangler dry-run rehearsal against the crawl-remote checkout; accepted `index.js`, `index.js.map`, and `README.md`, then packaged only `index.js`
- all seven current crawl-remote migrations passed the exact-name and exact-SHA-256 release packager
- `git diff --check`

## Rollout status

No production rollout was attempted. The unique protected-environment Cloudflare token and its fingerprint still need operator provisioning; do not create a repository-level fallback.
